editor.tabSize.description: Tab size. Number of columns a tab character occupies.

editor.indentSize.description: Indent size. Number of columns of one indentation level.

editor.insertSpaces.description: Indent with spaces. Pressing Tab inserts spaces instead of a tab character.

editor.detectIndentation.description: Detect indentation. Guesses the tab size and whether to indent with spaces or tabs from the opened file.

editor.wordWrap.description: Word wrap. Wraps long lines at the window edge.

editor.renderWhitespace.description: Show whitespace. Draws spaces and tab characters.

editor.fontFamily.description: Font family. Comma-separated list of font families, the first installed one is used.

editor.fontSize.description: Font size. Font size in points.

files.encoding.description: Default encoding. Encoding used for new files and for files whose encoding cannot be detected.

files.eol.description: End of line. Line ending for new files. Auto uses the platform default.

files.trimTrailingWhitespace.description: Trim trailing whitespace. Removes spaces and tabs at line ends when saving.

files.insertFinalNewline.description: Insert final newline. Adds a line ending at the end of the file when saving.

files.autoSave.description: Auto save. Saves changed files to their own path.

workbench.keymapProfile.description: Keymap profile. Id of the keymap profile layered over the default keys.

workbench.uiLanguage.description: Interface language. Language of menus and messages. Auto follows the system.

editor.autoClosePairs.description: Paired characters. Adds the closing character after a bracket or quote.

editor.continueComments.description: Continue comments. Enter inside a comment starts the next line as a comment.

workbench.theme.description: Theme. Light, dark or follow the system.

files.journalDirectory.description: Journal folder. Where unsaved work is written continuously for crash recovery. Empty: the profile folder.

files.journalFallbackDirectory.description: Journal fallback folder. Used when the main journal folder cannot be written. Empty: the system temp folder.

files.relatedFileRules.description: Related file rules. Pairs of file name endings that belong together, written as ending|ending and separated by semicolons, for example .vert|.frag;.scss|.css. They are tried before the built-in rules.

files.largeFileThreshold.description: Large file threshold (MiB). A file above this size opens in the paged mode, which edits the file in place without loading the whole text.

tools.diffTool.description: External diff tool. Path of a program that compares two files. Empty: Compare with Disk says what is missing.

tools.diffArguments.description: Diff tool arguments. Argument template; {left} is the file on disk, {right} the content of the tab.

editor.profile.description: Behaviour profile. Keys and editing behaviour: the default set or the one that follows PSPad.

editor.enhancedHomeEnd.description: Smart Home and End. Home jumps between the first non-blank character and the line start, End between the last non-blank character and the line end.

editor.backspaceUnindent.description: Backspace in indentation. Backspace at the end of the indentation removes spaces back to the previous tab stop.

editor.altDragMode.description: Alt+drag. What dragging with Alt held makes: one caret per row, or a block selection.

editor.pairStyle.description: Pair rules. Rules for adding closing brackets and quotes: the default ones or the ones of PSPad.

editor.smartKeys.renameTag.description: Rename paired tag. Editing the name of an HTML or XML tag changes the matching tag too.

editor.smartKeys.closeTag.description: Complete closing tag. Typing </ after an open tag adds its name and the closing bracket.

editor.smartKeys.escapeInString.description: Escape on paste into a string. Pasted quotes and backslashes are escaped inside a string literal.

editor.smartKeys.jsonComma.description: Commas in JSON. Enter at the end of a JSON value adds the missing comma when another value follows.

editor.smartKeys.phpArrow.description: Arrow after a PHP variable. Typing - right after a PHP variable adds ->.

editor.smartKeys.selectVariable.description: Select PHP variable without $. A double click on a PHP variable selects its name without the dollar sign.

editor.smartKeys.sqlEnd.description: Close BEGIN with END. Enter after BEGIN in SQL adds a matching END line.

files.binaryAsHex.description: Binary files in hex. What happens when a file has a NUL byte in its first 8,000 bytes: ask with a bar, always open in hex, or never switch.
